about: Lane H of the history fix (v5.1.2): the conversation reaches the request. A turn's history comes from the conversation cache (one page of card reads at most), the idle pump fills the cache after a restart a page a pass (historyCacheTick at the end of pollJobs), and the fold slice reads forward from thru with the after cursor. Each is measured on its own so a deeper store read shows here first.

paths.name: turn history read (TurnEngine::historyWindow)
paths._why: every turn: the cache's delta after the newest row held, or one newest-first page after a restart

paths.name: idle cache fill (TurnEngine::historyIdleStep)
paths._why: pollJobs calls it once per pump pass: one before-cursor page of the store (ring, index or card)

paths.name: fold slice forward read (TurnEngine::historyFoldSlice)
paths._why: a fold cycle's start: after-cursor pages from thru, the cold region included
